_description: Single source of truth for the add-on's version. Everything user-facing that shows a version reads from here (see `surfaces`), and `test/ui/version-manifest.test.js` fails if any of them drift. Update this file in the same commit as the release, never separately.
_prefsSchemaVersion: Must equal PREFS_SCHEMA_CURRENT_ in apps-script/migrations.gs. This is the user-data schema, not the add-on version: it only ever increases, and it increases whenever a new preference key ships. A mismatch means either a migration landed without a version bump or the reverse — both leave upgrading users in a state no migration covers.
_surfaces: Every place the version string is shown to a user. An agent bumping the version must update all of them; the manifest test checks they agree.

surfaces.note: About tab meta-pill. Shows MAJOR.MINOR only — patch releases do not change it.
Shown on install and from the release-notes dialog.

_changelog: docs/CHANGELOG.md must carry a heading for this version once status is 'released'. While 'pending-release' the entries live under 'Unreleased' headings and get consolidated at release time.
_deployment: Apps Script has no manifest version field — appsscript.json carries no version, and `clasp push` overwrites the head deployment. This file is the only version record the project has, which is exactly why it must not drift.
